projects.title: Portfolio OS — Personal Developer Operating System
projects.shortDescription: A unified developer platform combining a public portfolio with private study, testing, finance and personal management tools.
projects.description: Portfolio OS is a full-stack personal operating system designed around both professional presentation and everyday developer productivity. The public side works as a polished portfolio, while the private side brings study management, knowledge testing, finance tracking and portfolio administration into one platform.
features: Full Stack, DSA and AI study tracks
challenges: Designing multiple product areas inside one consistent system
Keeping private data secure and properly authorized
Structuring study, testing and finance workflows without making the interface overwhelming
learnings: Designing large full-stack applications as modular systems
Working with relational data through Prisma and PostgreSQL
Building authenticated and authorization-aware application flows
Creating reusable structures for dashboards and management tools

projects.title: Syntvex — Digital Growth & Technology Platform
projects.shortDescription: A technology platform focused on helping businesses strengthen their digital presence and build scalable growth systems.
projects.description: Syntvex is a digital technology platform built around practical business growth. Its focus is on helping businesses establish a stronger digital presence, automate useful workflows and build technology systems that can evolve as the business grows.
challenges: Communicating technical value in a business-friendly way
Balancing a professional brand experience with clear product information
Keeping the platform flexible for different business requirements
learnings: Designing technology products around business problems
Communicating technical services through clear product positioning
Thinking about scalability from the early product stage

projects.title: Krishi — Local Services Discovery Platform
projects.shortDescription: A local-services platform for discovering nearby stores, doctors, salons, transport and educational services.
projects.description: Krishi is a local-services discovery platform built to make nearby services easier to search and access. The project follows a multi-application architecture with dedicated server, web and mobile layers backed by a shared PostgreSQL data source.
challenges: Keeping web, mobile and backend layers aligned
Designing a consistent experience across different application surfaces
Handling local search data efficiently
learnings: Working with multi-application project architecture
Separating presentation, business logic and data access layers
Building products that share one backend across web and mobile clients

projects.title: Amraj — Local Services Search Platform
projects.shortDescription: A fast local search platform for finding useful services by city or pincode.
projects.description: Amraj is a focused local-services search platform built around quick discovery. Users can search for doctors, stores, salons, transport and educational services by city or pincode, with an emphasis on finding useful information with minimal friction.
challenges: Keeping search results relevant and easy to scan
Structuring local data for fast discovery
Designing a simple experience around information-heavy results
learnings: Designing search-first user experiences
Working with location-oriented datasets
Reducing unnecessary interaction steps in discovery flows

projects.title: PlusAI — AI Chat Assistant
projects.shortDescription: An AI chat application connecting users with an AI model through an API-driven conversational interface.
projects.description: PlusAI is an AI chat application focused on providing a clean conversational experience through external AI model integration. The project handles user messages, API communication and AI-generated responses through a simple chat-oriented interface.
challenges: Designing a smooth chat interaction
Handling asynchronous AI API requests
Keeping the interface simple while supporting dynamic responses
learnings: Integrating external AI services into web applications
Working with asynchronous API workflows
Designing interfaces around conversational interactions

projects.title: JP Construction — Construction Management Software
projects.shortDescription: A construction management system for workers, attendance, payments, files and administrative operations.
projects.description: JP Construction is a management system designed to simplify day-to-day construction administration. It brings worker management, attendance, payments, reporting, file handling and security controls into a single application.
challenges: Protecting administrative and employee data
Handling file uploads and generated reports securely
Combining operational workflows with security controls
learnings: Building business-oriented management systems
Applying application security practices
Working with PHP and MySQL in a traditional server environment

projects.title: OutbreakSense AI — AI-Powered Disease Risk Prediction Platform
projects.shortDescription: An AI-powered platform for location-based disease risk prediction, citizen reporting, realtime alerts and administrative analytics.
projects.description: OutbreakSense AI combines machine-learning based risk prediction with realtime reporting and location-based visualization. The platform is designed for both citizens and administrators, providing risk insights, reporting workflows, alerts, analytics and operational dashboards.
features: Risk score and risk level output
challenges: Connecting machine-learning services with a realtime application
Handling location-based data and visualizing it clearly
Designing reliable fallback behavior when AI services are unavailable
Keeping citizen and admin workflows understandable within one product
learnings: Integrating Python machine-learning services with a JavaScript backend
Building realtime applications with Socket.IO
Working with maps, geospatial visualization and data-heavy dashboards
Designing systems with fallback and resilience in mind

projects.title: HumanSafety — Emergency & Community Safety Platform
projects.shortDescription: A safety platform connecting people with emergency services, nearby support and location-based assistance.
projects.description: HumanSafety is a safety-focused mobile platform designed to help people access emergency support, discover nearby services and share important location information with trusted users and service providers.
challenges: Designing safety-critical user flows that remain easy to access
Working with multiple service-provider roles
Handling location-related features across different user journeys
learnings: Designing mobile applications around real-world workflows
Working with location-aware product features
Thinking about role-based systems from a user perspective

projects.title: Guddoo General Store — Local E-Commerce & Village Services Platform
projects.shortDescription: A complete local e-commerce platform with online ordering, UPI payments, credit tracking and digital village services.
projects.description: Guddoo General Store is a local-commerce platform built for general stores and village communities. It combines product discovery, online ordering, digital payments and store management with practical village services inside one system.
challenges: Combining e-commerce and local service workflows in one platform
Designing the system for both customers and store administrators
Supporting payments, credit tracking and order states without making the experience complex
Making the platform practical for mobile-first local usage
learnings: Building complete end-to-end commerce workflows
Working with Supabase authentication and PostgreSQL
Designing role-based admin and customer experiences
Building PWA-oriented web applications for mobile usage
